notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
Your feedback makes the game better! Today we released a major update based on your most important requests. For example, the diary now always opens on the last page you closed it on.

 
List of changes in patch 1.2:
 
Bugs:
1) Fixed a bug that caused a green stripe to appear at the bottom of the screen.

2) Fixed a bug with an inactive chest in the “Village” location.

3) Fixed a bug on the “Village” map when interacting with Stepan Razin's well.

 
Content:
1) A section with finds has been added to the main menu — now you can collect items.

2) A section with interesting notes on anomalous zones has been added to the main menu — real quotes from tourists who visited the Zhigulevsky Mountains.

3) A “Read” button has been added to the diary.

4) The mechanism for displaying content in the diary has been improved.

5) Now the diary opens on the page where it was closed.

6) A visual display of the saving process has been added.

7) The speed of backpack searches has been increased.

8) Changes have been made to the “Cave” map to improve the gaming experience.

9) Additional environment elements have been added to the “Village” map.

 

Now is the time to play Temple of the Green Moon, if you haven't already!

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
We support the game, analyze feedback, and regularly release updates. Today, the project received a global patch.

 
Fixes:
1) Fixed some save points.

2) Fixed issues with the lantern.

3) Fixed issues with the door in the hut at the “Shore” location.

4) Added additional collisions to prevent the most cunning players from getting through.

5) Fixed phrases spoken by the fortune teller in the “Village” location and added subtitles to them

6) Fixed the incorrectly working “Superman” achievement

7) Fixed some subtitles in the “Cave” that were not working correctly

 
Content additions:
1) Replaced the actor's reaction to fear to immerse the player more in the atmosphere.

2) Made the monster's appearance in the “Dungeon” location more varied.

3) Added a newspaper clipping to the “Village” location that reveals more about the lore of these places.

4) Removed 2 hatches in the “Cave” location at the request of players.

5) Added a very interesting magazine, you will definitely like it if you find it 😊.

6) Worked on the sounds in the “Cave” for a better atmosphere.

7) Added additional content to the diary, which will immerse you even more in the story.

 

Thank you for your comments, streams, and reviews. It means a lot to our team! We appreciate every word and work hard for you!

notes.title: Locations in the game: from modern times to the 14th century
notes.content:
Traveling blogger Maxim in the Samara region will not be limited to the modern setting. The unique idea of the project was that Max gets into an anomalous zone, where everything moves not according to the laws of time, physics, reasonable sense. Before the player will open not just the caves of the Zhigulev Mountains or the shore on the Volga. Each location is a transition, sometimes to a new era, a kind of time travel.

What locations are waiting for Max and the players?

 ship Samara
 Volga river bank
 dangerous cave of the Zhigulev Mountains
 a gloomy dungeon at the turn of the 14th century
 lost castle of the 14th century
 path out of time and space
 abandoned village of the 19th century

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693591/daf2920eebca7b405656098dd14a2742fa4cd0e6.jpg

Each location is unique, carries its own message, filled with collectibles and lore. We realize that it was easier to create a game on one location, for example, Max gets to the village and all the events take place there. And believe me, there is a lot of room for a couple or three hours of gameplay. But we liked the idea of smoothly leading the player into this crazy adventure, introducing the variety of possibilities, throwing more thematic features. 

For example, each era has its own identifying marks
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693591/f2754fc50012d6b9da4c310c64ac3f00109b20df.jpg

its own loot bags
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693591/aefd57ab14261de69f2ace9cf6cd989835888c87.jpg

its own finds and memories, its own types of monsters, and even its own seasons and weather.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693591/6030a30ea7253654c6c01e26c9ffe62c8a7e12bf.jpg

The total passage time, according to our predictions, will take 6-7 hours.

Together with you we are waiting for the start of this journey. Blogger Maxim Elizarov will soon go to the Samara region to dispel the myths about this anomalous zone.

notes.title: Characters and monsters in the game
notes.content:
All NPCs in the game are made by hand. This is important to note, as indie developers often use special services that help generate characters. For example, MetaHuman.

But in The Temple of the Green Moon every character and monster is rendered by our 3D artists and has an exclusive 3D model. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693591/fca29505ba87deb9826aab39e20bd1b8feca4f04.jpg

In the game you will meet important story characters: 

 a mysterious man whom you will meet in two different eras,
 an old ghost in a medieval castle, 
 a fortune-teller in an abandoned village. 


Key story characters will be featured in cutscenes with dialog and unique animations. 

In addition, the bestiary of the Temple of the Green Moon has been enriched with ghosts, runners, an unkillable monster in the castle library and other dangerous and original creatures.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693591/bef1edbb370750efbd52f091507025d854e30d72.jpg

We worked out each character separately, trying to achieve originality and authenticity in their appearance and behavior.

notes.title: What the Temple of the Green Moon will be like: our progress
notes.content:
After a year of work, we already have an idea of the game Temple of the Green Moon.

Our project is not only a walking simulator. We use game mechanics that will force the player to be an active participant in the events.

You will have to keep an eye on the charge of your flashlight and collect batteries. The hero of the game is not defenseless. He will be able to fight back the dangerous inhabitants from the mysterious places where you will get them.

The release version of the game Temple of the Green Moon will be more hardcore. But not only scary moments are waiting for you. The game will have a mysterious story and beautiful and safe locations. The Unreal Engine 5 engine capabilities allowed us to create realistic environments and fantastic locations!

The events of the game take place not only in caves and forests. You will visit sunny beaches, get into the winter cold. There is a possibility of sudden time travel!

In the Temple of the Green Moon are waiting for you:

 No less than 7 locations: caves, forest, bandit dungeons, sunny beaches, snowy plains, a 19th century hut and even a medieval castle
 OST of original indie music
 Character voice acting by professional actors who have worked on Uncharted, Assassin's Creed, Far Cry, Cyberpunk 2077 and other games and movies
 Dangerous enemies that you will be able to deal with in various ways
 Complex puzzles
 Traps
 And difficult moral choices in the story

notes.title: The demo update is now on Steam!
notes.content:
Some players noted the measured pace of the demo. But we generally considered it as a demonstration of mechanics: the main game will be different. Anyway, to please you, we added dynamics to the current version of the demo.

The list of updates is already waiting for you in Steam:
✅ Interface:
- tourist's memo added to the main menu
- changed graphics settings in the settings
- added disabling subtitles

✅ Content:
- added another monster and battle with it
- added another ghost
- added new sounds, corrected previous sounds
- added animated spiders on the web on the locations
- fixed some textures
- reduced time of backpack loot
- expanded safe zones
- added opening/closing of chests
- corrected effects when a character dies

✅ Errors:
- fixed a possible error when looting a backpack with an empty flashlight

Download the update! We look forward to your feedback to help improve the project!

notes.title: Voice acting in the game: what languages and actors are expected?
notes.content:
Voice-overs in games play a huge role, we all enjoy immersing ourselves in the process of passing, when we hear the emotions of the characters, live with them what is happening. That's why we decided to add voice-overs in Russian and English. 

There are not so many dialogs in the game, but they will be. The main character Max meets several people on his way (or not a person at all), and also sometimes comments on what is happening - a common technique that allows you to feel the hero, to catch his mood: irony, surprise, fear, despair.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693591/76a567e2233b6e50419cde87d5b5e0d8693aff43.jpg

Which voice actors are involved in the development?
Russian voice actors
Denis Bespaly - the voice of Nathan Drake in the Uncharted series, characters in Assassin's Creed, Far Cry, Cyberpunk 2077 and other games and movies
Alexandra Kizhaeva - voice in Control, Cyberpunk 2077 games
Mikhail Tikhonov - especially known for the voice of Dean from Supernatural, but has voiced a huge number of characters in movies and games, such as Assassin's Creed III, Batman: Arkham Asylum, StarCraft II: Wings of Liberty.

English voiceover
One of the characters and the first teaser is voiced by singer and actor Brandon Baumann. 

We are in talks with other actors for the roles of characters not yet voiced. And strive as much as possible to make our game “Temple of the Green Moon” sound atmospheric with a combination of professional voices and quality sound design.
